summary: Stoneridge, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that indirect subsidiary Orlaco Products BV entered an employment agreement on October 2, 2026 with Vivek Anand, effective November 2, 2026, as Vice President, Commercial Strategy Global Sales, reporting to CEO Natalia Noblet and serving on the executive team. Terms: €330,000 base salary (~$371,349), 50% target bonus, €50,000 sign-on bonus repayable if departure before November 2, 2027, and a one-time equity grant equivalent to €150,000 vesting over one year. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics; this is a routine executive-hiring compensation disclosure, not a special situation.
